rooms.name: Grand Lobby
rooms.purpose: Marble is loud: cross on the rugs. The atrium lets you see (and hear) the guest floor galleries. CCTV.

rooms.name: Entrance Vestibule
rooms.purpose: The street doors open on white static: the edge of the tape. No way out.

rooms.name: Luggage Room
rooms.purpose: Luggage cage to hide in. Glass bottles (throw one to make a noise somewhere else).

rooms.name: Front Office
rooms.purpose: START. The previous viewer's letter explains everything. Door to the reception desk.

rooms.name: Concierge
rooms.purpose: Desk radio: switch it on to lure it to the lobby. Second door to the staff passage (a loop).

rooms.name: West Staff Passage
rooms.purpose: The quiet back route behind the front-of-house rooms. Every room has a second door here.

rooms.name: Staff Lockers
rooms.purpose: Lockers to hide in. A portable radio to carry and set down as a lure.

rooms.name: Security Office
rooms.purpose: CCTV monitors of all three floors: find it before you go anywhere. Connecting door to the manager's office.

rooms.name: Manager's Office
rooms.purpose: The wall safe with the basement key (a four-digit code, in two halves upstairs). The hotel's story in the files. Desk to hide under.

rooms.name: Mail Room
rooms.purpose: Letters from earlier viewers (dated after 2003) that were never collected.

rooms.name: Staff Stair
rooms.purpose: Ground floor to guest floor, away from the lobby. Two flights.

rooms.name: Chapel
rooms.purpose: The organ: the loudest lure in the hotel. Pews to hide behind. Three doors.

rooms.name: Restaurant
rooms.purpose: Piano (lure). Tables with long cloths to hide under. The crashed chandelier: glass all round it.

rooms.name: Dish Pit
rooms.purpose: Stacked plates: knock them and everything hears. Short cut between restaurant and kitchen.

rooms.name: Cold Room
rooms.purpose: Heavy door you can pull shut from inside: a hiding place it doesn't hear into.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.purpose: Tile and hanging pans: a loud room. Swing doors to the restaurant. Bottles.

rooms.name: North Staff Corridor
rooms.purpose: Links the staff stair, chapel, restaurant, kitchen and the locked basement door.

rooms.name: East Service Hall
rooms.purpose: The east back route: gift shop, telephones, bar storage, kitchen.

rooms.name: Gift Shop
rooms.purpose: Music box on the counter (a quiet lure that plays for a while).

rooms.name: Blue Note Bar
rooms.purpose: Jukebox (lure). Broken glass behind the bar (loud). Bottles to throw.

rooms.name: Telephone Room
rooms.purpose: Payphones: dial a guest room to make its phone ring upstairs.

rooms.name: Bar Storage
rooms.purpose: Crates of bottles (throwables). Shelving to hide behind.

rooms.name: Laundry Chute Room
rooms.purpose: The chute from the guest floor falls past here to the basement laundry. Drop a bottle down it: it smashes in the basement.

rooms.name: Basement Stairhead
rooms.purpose: LOCKED: the key is in the manager's safe. Down these stairs is part two.

rooms.name: Service Lift Lobby
rooms.purpose: The dead lift. It climbs the shaft between floors: you hear it inside.

rooms.name: Loading Dock
rooms.purpose: The roller door opens on static. Rubble.

rooms.name: West Gallery
rooms.purpose: Overlooks the lobby.

rooms.name: North Gallery
rooms.purpose: House phone (the switchboard can ring it). Seen from reception. CCTV.

rooms.name: East Gallery
rooms.purpose: Overlooks the lobby; the grand stair arrives at its north end.

rooms.name: South Mezzanine
rooms.purpose: Writing desks above the entrance; joins the galleries into a full loop round the atrium.

rooms.name: West Corridor
rooms.purpose: Guest corridor. The north end is half blocked by fallen ceiling (rubble is loud). CCTV.

rooms.name: West Cross Hall
rooms.purpose: Joins the west corridor to the galleries.

rooms.name: Room 201
rooms.purpose: Wardrobe. Connecting door to 203.

rooms.name: Room 203
rooms.purpose: Bed to hide under. Note about bolting doors.

rooms.name: Room 205
rooms.purpose: The TV: switch it on and it comes to watch (a lure). Note about lures.

rooms.name: Room 207
rooms.purpose: Burnt out. Ash and glass underfoot: loud. A hole through to 209.

rooms.name: Room 209
rooms.purpose: The fire started here. Its corridor door is jammed; reach it through 207. The previous viewer's bag, with the other half of the safe code.

rooms.name: Room 202
rooms.purpose: Wardrobe. The minibar bottles are still here (throwables).

rooms.name: Room 204
rooms.purpose: Radio on the nightstand (lure).

rooms.name: Room 206
rooms.purpose: Bathtub to hide in.

rooms.name: Room 208
rooms.purpose: Small single. Bottles on the minibar.

rooms.name: Housekeeping
rooms.purpose: Linen carts to hide in. Staff door into the ballroom.

rooms.name: Ice & Vending
rooms.purpose: Vending machine: buy a can (one loud thump). The ice machine hums and covers your steps.

rooms.name: Ballroom
rooms.purpose: Where it waits at the start. Grand piano (lure). Stage curtains to hide behind. Three ways out.

rooms.name: Guest North Corridor
rooms.purpose: Links the staff stair, linen chute, ballroom, lift and the east wing.

rooms.name: Linen Chute
rooms.purpose: The laundry chute down to the basement. Something drops down it now and then.

rooms.name: Lift Vestibule
rooms.purpose: The dead lift. It goes into the shaft here when it leaves the floor.

rooms.name: East Cross Hall
rooms.purpose: Joins the galleries to the east corridor.

rooms.name: East Corridor
rooms.purpose: Wet carpet near 214 (squelches). CCTV.

rooms.name: Room 212
rooms.purpose: Connecting door into 214: the quiet way in.

rooms.name: Room 214
rooms.purpose: Half of the safe code, behind the dresser. The front door's lock sticks. Mirror. Connecting doors to 212 and 216.

rooms.name: Room 216
rooms.purpose: Wardrobe. Connecting door into 214.

rooms.name: Room 218
rooms.purpose: Telephone with a long cord; the bed to hide under.

rooms.name: Room 211
rooms.purpose: Corner suite. Record player (lure).

rooms.name: Room 213
rooms.purpose: Its door is bolted from inside (it can't open a bolted door). Get in through 215's connecting door: a safe room.

rooms.name: Room 215
rooms.purpose: Wardrobe. Connecting door to 213.

rooms.name: Room 217
rooms.purpose: Bathtub to hide in.

rooms.name: Linen Store
rooms.purpose: Shelves to hide behind. Bottles of bleach (throwables).

rooms.name: Maid's Office
rooms.purpose: Monitors for the guest floor cameras.

rooms.name: Staff Lounge
rooms.purpose: TV and sofa. A note from the hotel's night staff.

rooms.name: Room 219
rooms.purpose: Honeymoon suite. Music box (lure). Wardrobe.

rooms.name: Basement Stair
rooms.purpose: From the ground floor. Emergency light.

rooms.name: Main Corridor
rooms.purpose: Puddles under the dripping pipes (splash). CCTV.

rooms.name: Laundry
rooms.purpose: Washing machines: start one to lure it and cover your noise. The chute drops here.

rooms.name: Boiler Room
rooms.purpose: The boiler roars on and off: while it roars, it can't hear you. Hide behind it.

rooms.name: Pump Room
rooms.purpose: The service lift: call it from here (30 s, the bell is loud). Two doors you can bolt. It comes down the shaft here too.

rooms.name: Electrical Room
rooms.purpose: The main breaker, with no fuse in it. Very loud when thrown. Powers the lights and the lift.

rooms.name: Recorder Room
rooms.purpose: The night engineer's room: the lift key on the desk. The monitors show where the tape really goes: up, to the roof. The door bolts from inside.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.purpose: Maintenance log. A portable radio. Tools on the bench (a dropped one rings out).

rooms.name: Storage Cages
rooms.purpose: The spare main fuse, in the end cage. Chain-link cages and boxes to hide behind; two doors to the corridor.

rooms.name: Coal Store
rooms.purpose: Coal underfoot (loud). It rests here between hunts.

rooms.name: Wine Cellar
rooms.purpose: Racks of bottles (throwables). Narrow aisles to hide in. Back way to the electrical room.

rooms.name: Flooded Passage
rooms.purpose: Knee-deep water: every step splashes. A risky short cut.

rooms.name: Hotel Archive
rooms.purpose: Shelves of tapes labelled 31.10.2003, one for every viewer. What the tape is.

rooms.name: Generator Room
rooms.purpose: Start the generator: a big noise for a minute (lure and cover).

rooms.name: South Corridor
rooms.purpose: The long back way along the south of the basement. Dark.

rooms.name: Penthouse Corridor
rooms.purpose: The owner's floor: walnut panelling and portraits of earlier viewers, faces worn away. The lift at one end, the roof door in the middle, the owner's chained door.

rooms.name: PH Lift Lobby
rooms.purpose: The lift brings you up and dies. It comes out of the shaft here too.

rooms.name: Butler's Pantry
rooms.purpose: Bottles (throwables). A shelf to hide behind.

rooms.name: Roof Stair
rooms.purpose: Up to the roof. The door from the corridor reads the owner's keycard.

rooms.name: Plant Room
rooms.purpose: The air handler: start it and it drones for a minute (a lure, and it covers noise nearby).

rooms.name: Servants' Passage
rooms.purpose: A one-metre passage behind the walls: the staff's way into the owner's rooms. Tight, nowhere to hide in it.

rooms.name: Suite 901
rooms.purpose: An art deco guest suite: parquet, a clawfoot bath, a writing desk. A door into the servants' passage: one way in to the owner's rooms.

rooms.name: Owner's Suite
rooms.purpose: The owner's screening room: a wall of monitors, shelves of tapes, cables everywhere. Chained from the corridor. Grand piano (lure), a bar, a fireplace, sofas to hide behind.

rooms.name: Owner's Study
rooms.purpose: THE ROOF KEYCARD in the desk. The owner's diary: why the hotel records its guests.

rooms.name: Owner's Bedroom
rooms.purpose: Bed to hide under. Mirror. A door through to Suite 903.

rooms.name: Suite 903
rooms.purpose: TV (lure). Bathtub to hide in. The other way into the owner's rooms.

rooms.name: Roof Deck
rooms.purpose: Gravel (loud) and puddles. Water tanks and air units to hide behind. The storm siren on its mast in the south-west corner: the big lure.

rooms.name: Lift Machine Room
rooms.purpose: The lift motor over the shaft. It climbs out here.

rooms.name: Antenna Room
rooms.purpose: THE GOAL: the master VCR, broadcasting you. The door bolts, but it breaks a bolt in four blows. Hold eject for 18 s; let go and the tape winds back.

rooms.name: Siren Housing
rooms.purpose: Tools, the siren's spare horn. A place to hide.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.purpose: Prologue: you wake up here.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.purpose: The fireplace, the sofa, the TV and the VCR.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.purpose: Fridge, stove, toaster, kettle, microwave, the fruit bowl.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.purpose: Coats, shoes, keys; the front door.

objects.label: THE NIGHT MANAGER'S LOG, 31 OCTOBER 2003
objects.detail:
22:40  Last guests checked in. The hotel closes tomorrow.
23:10  Complaints: knocking inside the service lift shaft.
23:41  Security: camera 1 shows someone standing in the lobby. The lobby is empty.
23:58  The figure on camera 1 has no face. It is walking towards the camera.
00:00  The master recorder will not stop. We are leaving it running.
00:06  Basement key in my safe. I have torn the combination in two and hidden the halves upstairs (214, and the guest in 209 has the other). Nobody goes down there tonight.

(The log ends there.)

objects.label: THE OWNER'S DIARY
objects.detail:
1 November 2003

The master in the antenna room has not stopped since midnight. It isn't recording the hotel any more. It is broadcasting it.

Every copy of the tape is a window, and whoever looks through one is let in. The building keeps them. I have their faces on the corridor wall.

The keycard for the roof is in this desk. I am not going up there again. It sits in the lift motor room when it is quiet, right next door to the antenna room.

objects.label: NOTEPAD BY THE PHONE
objects.detail:
Half the safe code is behind the dresser. Pulling the dresser out scrapes, loud.

Do it when it's far away, or make a noise somewhere else first. The phone by the bed rings other rooms.

objects.label: TAPED TO THE PA AMPLIFIER
objects.detail:
The horn on the mast (south-west corner) is the hotel's old PA. Switch it on and the whole roof hears the lift music.

It went straight to it and stood under it a long time before it tore it down. That was when I got into the antenna room.

Bolt the door. It still breaks a bolt in four blows.

— the one before you

IN THE BAG

My bag. I came back up here to hide after the basement. The other half of the safe code is in the side pocket.

The guest floor is safest when it's downstairs. Footsteps on marble: it's in the lobby. Footsteps on carpet: it's close.

objects.label: THE BOARD ABOVE THE DESK
objects.detail:
Photographs pinned in rows, each one a still from a security camera: somebody in the lobby, looking up at the lens.

Under each a date in the owner's hand. 2006. 2011. 2015. 2019. 2023.

The last pin holds nothing yet. The card under it says today's date.

The owner says nobody goes up to the roof. Not for the antenna, not for the tanks, not for anything.

Use the passage behind the suites, not the corridor. He doesn't like being walked past.

objects.label: A LETTER, LEFT ON THE DESK
objects.detail:
If you're reading this, you put the tape in. So did I.

This is the hotel's last night, 31 October 2003. Something walks these floors. It HEARS you, and it only sees you in bright light.

· Crouch to move without a sound. Running carries.
· Keep to the dark, and mind your camera light (F).
· Film the fire plans on the walls (E). M shows the map.

The way out starts in the BASEMENT. Its key is in the MANAGER'S SAFE. The code is torn in two: ROOM 214, behind the dresser, and ROOM 209, through the hole in 207.

— the one before you

objects.label: PINNED BY THE BASEMENT STAIRS
objects.detail:
Down there:

· The lights are dead. The MAIN BREAKER (electrical room, west end) has no fuse: the spare is in the STORAGE CAGES. Throwing it is LOUD.
· The recorder room isn't the end. The cable from its machine goes up the lift shaft, all the way to the roof. The LIFT KEY is on the engineer's desk in there.
· The lift call panel is in the PUMP ROOM. The car takes half a minute to come down and the bell rings the whole time. It comes for the bell, and it breaks bolts when it's like that.
· Start the GENERATOR first (south-east). It stands over the generator a long time before it tears it apart.
· The boiler roars every minute or so. While it roars, it can't hear you.

— me

objects.label: A NOTE ON THE DESK
objects.detail:
Every guest room has a bolt on the inside of the door. It can't open a bolted door. It hits it a few times and goes away.

A bolted room with a connecting door is a good way to lose it.

objects.label: Dresser
objects.detail: Hold E to pull it out: every pull scrapes (55 dB). The key is behind it.

objects.label: Owner's keycard
objects.detail: Part three: the owner's keycard, in the study desk. Opens the roof door.

objects.label: Spare main fuse
objects.detail: Part two: the spare main fuse, in the end cage. The breaker needs it.

objects.label: Other half of the safe code
objects.detail: Part one: the other half of the safe code, in the previous viewer's bag in Room 209 (through 207).

objects.label: Torn half of the safe code
objects.detail: Part one: half of the safe code, behind the dresser in Room 214.

objects.label: Lift key
objects.detail: Part two: the lift key, on the recorder room desk. The lift call panel needs it.

objects.label: Manager's wall safe
objects.detail: Part one: needs both halves of the code. The basement key is inside.

objects.label: Lift call panel
objects.detail: Part two: needs power and the lift key. Calling rings a bell for 30 s (64 dB every 2 s): it comes, hurrying, and breaks bolts. Draw it away first (the generator holds it 14 s).

objects.label: Main breaker
objects.detail: Hold E to throw it: 72 dB, heard across the basement. Powers the basement lights and the recorder room.

objects.label: Master VCR (the goal)
objects.detail: Needs power. Hold E 12 s to eject the tape: it grinds (60 dB each second) and it comes. Bolt the door first.

objects.label: Your VCR
objects.detail: Put the tape in.

objects.label: The envelope
objects.detail: It comes through the letterbox once you reach the front door: the tape and a card, "PLAY ME".

objects.label: Sniff the milk
objects.detail:
It's... fine. Probably.
You drink straight from the carton. Nobody saw.
Beans. Not now.

objects.label: Sit down for a second
objects.detail:
You sink into the sofa. Comfortable. Too comfortable.
The cushion still has the shape of you.
You get up before you fall asleep again.

objects.label: Run the tap
objects.detail:
Cold water. You drink from your hand.
The pipes knock. Old house.

objects.label: Look at the painting
objects.detail:
A lighthouse in a storm. You bought it because it was cheap.
It's crooked. You straighten it. It's still crooked.

objects.label: Look at the vase
objects.detail: Empty. You keep meaning to buy flowers.

objects.label: Eat the pear
objects.detail:
Juicy. Sticky fingers now.
Core and all? No.

objects.label: Turn on a ring
objects.detail:
The ring glows orange. You turn it off again. You weren't going to cook.
You hold your hand over it. Warm.

objects.label: Eat the apple
objects.detail:
Crunchy.
Better than whatever they serve at that hotel. Probably.

objects.label: Check the clock
objects.detail:
11:34 PM. Who rings a doorbell at this hour?
It ticks. Very loud, now you're awake.
You put it face down. Better.

objects.label: Fluff the pillows
objects.detail:
Better.
You consider going back to bed. The doorbell disagrees.

objects.label: Eat the croissant
objects.detail:
Yesterday's. Still good.
Flakes everywhere.

objects.label: Look through the old tapes
objects.detail:
'Holiday, 1998'.
'Mum's 60th'.
'DO NOT TAPE OVER'. Somebody taped over it.

objects.label: Touch the plant
objects.detail: Plastic. You've watered it for years.

objects.label: Run the microwave
objects.detail:
There's nothing in it. You run it anyway.
The plate turns. Nothing on it. Hypnotic.

objects.label: Read the TV guide
objects.detail:
Friday 31 October 2003. There's nothing on.
A circle round 11:45 PM, channel 0. There is no channel 0.

objects.label: Look at the photo
objects.detail:
You, at the seaside. You don't remember who took it.
You look happy. You look tired.

objects.label: Drink the soda
objects.detail: Fizz. Sugar at midnight. Great idea.

objects.label: Warm your hands
objects.detail:
Warm.
You hold your hands to the fire. Toasty.
You poke the logs. A shower of sparks.

objects.label: Pick up your keys
objects.detail:
Your keys. You're not going anywhere tonight.
You put them back. In exactly the same place.

objects.label: Look at your shoes
objects.detail:
Still wet. You walked home in the rain.
Your good shoes. You never wear them.

objects.label: Sit down
objects.detail:
You sit at the table. Nobody to talk to.
You get up again.

objects.label: Eat a bun
objects.detail:
A plain bun. Dry. Very dry.
You're eating dry buns at midnight. Reflect on that.

objects.label: Look in the cabinet
objects.detail:
Jumpers, folded. Nothing suitable for a haunted hotel.
Your good coat. You never go anywhere good.

objects.label: Open the drawer
objects.detail:
Knives, forks, one spoon. Where do the spoons go?
The drawer sticks. It always sticks.

objects.label: Plump the cushions
objects.detail:
Plump.
Perfect. Nobody will notice.

objects.label: Open the fridge
objects.detail:
The fridge light. Cold air on your face.
Still the same things in there.
You stare into the fridge. The fridge stares back.

objects.label: Peek through the letterbox
objects.detail:
Rain. The street light. Nobody.
Just the rain.

objects.label: Bite the lemon
objects.detail: Why did you do that.

objects.label: Pour a cup of tea
objects.detail:
Cold tea. You drink it anyway.
The pot's empty now.

objects.label: Check the clock
objects.detail:
11:36. Late.
It chimes. It always chimes at the wrong time.

objects.label: Eat a banana
objects.detail:
Potassium.
Another banana. Why not.
That was the last banana. Someone will be upset. You.

objects.label: Water the plant
objects.detail:
You've got nothing to water it with. You give it a pep talk instead.
It looks disappointed.

objects.label: Straighten the plates
objects.detail:
Neat.
You stack them again. Neater.

objects.label: Switch the radio off
objects.detail:
Soft piano. Late-night radio.
Quiet. You can hear the rain again.

objects.label: Check your coat pockets
objects.detail:
A bus ticket. A receipt for batteries. Lint.
Nothing new in the pockets.

objects.label: Sit down
objects.detail:
You sit at the table. Nobody to talk to.
You get up again.

objects.label: Change the channel
objects.detail:
Static.
More static.
A shopping channel. Then static.
Static. You could swear something moved in it.

objects.label: Put the kettle on
objects.detail:
You put the kettle on.
Tea fixes everything. Almost everything.

objects.label: Take a book
objects.detail:
Encyclopaedia, volume K. You read about kangaroos.
Volume M: magnetic tape. You put it back quickly.
Volume H: hotels. A page has been torn out.

objects.label: Look at the photo
objects.detail:
Your grandparents, on their wedding day.
Someone has written a date on the back: 31.10.2003. That's not their wedding.

objects.label: Make some toast
objects.detail:
Two slices in.
It pops. You jump. Every time.
You eat the toast standing up.

objects.label: Look at the wine
objects.detail:
It's a school night.
You don't have school. You still don't open it.

objects.label: Eat some crisps
objects.detail:
Salt and vinegar.
Crunch.
The bag is empty. You check again anyway.

objects.label: Check the clock
objects.detail:
11:37. It's always slow.
Tick. Tock. You should go to bed. Too late.

objects.label: Sit in the armchair
objects.detail:
Your chair. By the fire. Perfect.
You could sit here all night.

objects.label: Look in the basket
objects.detail:
Umbrellas. Three of them, all broken.
Gloves that don't match.

objects.label: Have a slice of cake
objects.detail:
A slice. Just one.
Another slice. Just one more.
Gone. You regret nothing.

objects.label: Washing machine
objects.detail: A washing machine: runs 45 s. A lure (it listens to it a while), and it covers noise near it. (58 dB at 1 m) Covers noise within 5 m.

objects.label: Piano
